title: पञ्चमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 5 · Ashvatthaman proposes Shalya as commander

summary.en: On the slopes of the Himalaya the Kauravas rest and discuss the next commander, and Ashvatthaman proposes Shalya, the king of Madra, whose loyalty has been proven. Duryodhana agrees and the leaders applaud, and the king asks him to take command.
summary.kn: ಹಿಮಾಲಯದ ಇಳಿಜಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೌರವರು ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಸೇನಾಪತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ ನಿಷ್ಠೆ ಸಾಬೀತಾದ ಮದ್ರರಾಜ ಶಲ್ಯನನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾನೆ, ನಾಯಕರು ಹರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸೇನಾಪತ್ಯ ವಹಿಸಲು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: हिमालय की ढलान पर कौरव विश्राम कर अगले सेनापति पर विचार करते हैं, और अश्वत्थामा निष्ठा सिद्ध मद्रराज शल्य का नाम सुझाता है। दुर्योधन सहमत होता है, नायक सराहते हैं, और राजा उनसे सेनापति बनने को कहता है।
summary.te: హిమాలయ వాలుపై కౌరవులు విశ్రమించి తదుపరి సేనాపతి గురించి చర్చిస్తారు; విధేయత నిరూపించుకున్న మద్రరాజు శల్యుని అశ్వత్థామ సూచిస్తాడు. దుర్యోధనుడు అంగీకరిస్తాడు, నాయకులు హర్షిస్తారు; సేనాపతిగా ఉండమని అతన్ని కోరతాడు.
summary.ta: இமயச் சரிவில் கௌரவர் ஓய்வெடுத்து அடுத்த தலைவரைப் பற்றி ஆலோசிக்க, விசுவாசம் நிரூபித்த மத்ர மன்னன் சல்யனை அஸ்வத்தாமன் முன்மொழிகிறான். துரியோதனன் ஒப்ப, தலைவர்கள் வரவேற்க, படைத்தலைமை ஏற்கும்படி அவனைக் கேட்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഹിമാലയച്ചരിവുകളിൽ കൗരവർ വിശ്രമിക്കുകയും അടുത്ത സേനാപതിയെക്കുറിച്ച് ചർച്ച ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; വിശ്വസ്തത തെളിയിച്ച മദ്രരാജാവായ ശല്യനെ അശ്വത്ഥാമാവ് നിർദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നു. ദുര്യോധനൻ സമ്മതിക്കുന്നു, നേതാക്കൾ കയ്യടിക്കുന്നു; രാജാവ് സേന ഏറ്റെടുക്കണമെന്ന് അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.5; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अथ हैमवते प्रस्थे स्थित्वा युद्धाभिनन्दिनः ।
सर्व एव महाराज योधास्तत्र समागताः ॥

meaning.en: Then, resting on the slope of the Himalaya, all the warriors who delighted in battle gathered there, great king.

verses.text:
शल्यश्च चित्रसेनश्च शकुनिश्च महारथः ।
अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Shalya, Chitrasena, the great warrior Shakuni, Ashvatthama, Kripa and Kritavarma the Satvata,

verses.text:
सुषेणोऽरिष्टसेनश्च धृतसेनश्च वीर्यवान् ।
जयत्सेनश्च राजानस्ते रात्रिमुषितास्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Sushena, Arishtasena, the valiant Dhritasena and Jayatsena, those kings spent the night there.

verses.text:
रणे कर्णे हते वीरे त्रासिता जितकाशिभिः ।
नालभञ्शर्म ते पुत्रा हिमवन्तमृते गिरिम् ॥

meaning.en: Terrified by the Pandava victors after the hero Karna fell in battle, your sons found no peace except in the mountain Himavat.

verses.text:
तेऽब्रुवन्सहितास्तत्र राजानं सैन्यसंनिधौ ।
कृतयत्ना रणे राजन्संपूज्य विधिवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Gathered there, having made every effort in the fight, they duly honored the king near the army and said:

verses.text:
कृत्वा सेनाप्रणेतारं परांस्त्वं योद्धुमर्हसि ।
येनाभिगुप्ताः संग्रामे जयेमासुहृदो वयम् ॥

meaning.en: "You must make someone the army's leader and then fight the enemy, so that, guarded by him in battle, we may defeat our foes."

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनः स्थित्वा रथे रथवरोत्तमम् ।
सर्वयुद्धविभागज्ञमन्तकप्रतिमं युधि ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, standing in his chariot, looked toward Ashvatthama, the best of charioteers, who was like Death in battle and knew every division of war,

verses.text:
स्वङ्गं प्रच्छन्नशिरसं कम्बुग्रीवं प्रियंवदम् ।
व्याकोशपद्माभिमुखं व्याघ्रास्यं मेरुगौरवम् ॥

meaning.en: well-limbed, with a covered head, a neck like a conch and sweet in speech, with a face like an open lotus, a tiger's mouth, the weight of Meru,

verses.text:
स्थाणोर्वृषस्य सदृशं स्कन्धनेत्रगतिस्वरैः ।
पुष्टश्लिष्टायतभुजं सुविस्तीर्णघनोरसम् ॥

meaning.en: like Shiva's bull in shoulders, eyes, gait and voice, with stout, well-joined long arms and a broad, solid chest,

verses.text:
जवे बले च सदृशमरुणानुजवातयोः ।
आदित्यस्य त्विषा तुल्यं बुद्ध्या चोशनसा समम् ॥

meaning.en: equal in speed and strength to Aruna's younger brother and the wind, like the sun in radiance and like Ushanas in intellect,

verses.text:
कान्तिरूपमुखैश्वर्यैस्त्रिभिश्चन्द्रमसोपमम् ।
काञ्चनोपलसंघातैः सदृशं श्लिष्टसंधिकम् ॥

meaning.en: like the moon in three things, charm, beauty and splendor, with firm joints like blocks of gold,

verses.text:
सुवृत्तोरुकटीजङ्घं सुपादं स्वङ्गुलीनखम् ।
स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वैव च गुणान्धात्रा यत्नाद्विनिर्मितम् ॥

meaning.en: with well-rounded thighs, hips and shanks, good feet, fine fingers and nails, shaped carefully by the Creator, remembering his qualities again and again,

verses.text:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं निपुणं श्रुतिसागरम् ।
जेतारं तरसारीणामजेयं शत्रुभिर्बलात् ॥

meaning.en: endowed with every mark of excellence, skilled, an ocean of learning, a swift conqueror of enemies, unconquerable by force,

verses.text:
दशाङ्गं यश्चतुष्पादमिष्वस्त्रं वेद तत्त्वतः ।
साङ्गांश्च चतुरो वेदान्सम्यगाख्यानपञ्चमान् ॥

meaning.en: who truly knows the bow and weapons in their ten parts and four feet, and the four Vedas with their limbs, with the epics as the fifth,

verses.text:
आराध्य त्र्यम्बकं यत्नाद्व्रतैरुग्रैर्महातपाः ।
अयोनिजायामुत्पन्नो द्रोणेनायोनिजेन यः ॥

meaning.en: who, a great ascetic, by fierce vows duly worshiped Tryambaka, and was born of an unwomb-born mother to the unwomb-born Drona,

verses.text:
तमप्रतिमकर्माणं रूपेणासदृशं भुवि ।
पारगं सर्वविद्यानां गुणार्णवमनिन्दितम् ।
तमभ्येत्यात्मजस्तुभ्यमश्वत्थामानमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: that man of matchless deeds, unequaled in form on earth, master of all knowledge, a blameless ocean of virtues; approaching him, your son, Ashvatthama, spoke to him.

verses.text:
यं पुरस्कृत्य सहिता युधि जेष्याम पाण्डवान् ।
गुरुपुत्रोऽद्य सर्वेषामस्माकं परमा गतिः ।
भवांस्तस्मान्नियोगात्ते कोऽस्तु सेनापतिर्मम ॥

meaning.en: "With him at our head we shall defeat the Pandavas together in battle; today the Guru's son is the supreme refuge of all of us. So by your command, who should be my army's commander?"

verses.text: द्रौणिरुवाच

meaning.en: Drona's son said:

verses.text:
अयं कुलेन वीर्येण तेजसा यशसा श्रिया ।
सर्वैर्गुणैः समुदितः शल्यो नोऽस्तु चमूपतिः ॥

meaning.en: "Shalya here, endowed with every quality of family, valor, splendor, fame and fortune, should be our leader."

verses.text:
भागिनेयान्निजांस्त्यक्त्वा कृतज्ञोऽस्मानुपागतः ।
महासेनो महाबाहुर्महासेन इवापरः ॥

meaning.en: "He left his own sister's sons and, grateful, came over to us; mighty-armed, he is a second Mahasena."

verses.text:
एनं सेनापतिं कृत्वा नृपतिं नृपसत्तम ।
शक्यः प्राप्तुं जयोऽस्माभिर्देवैः स्कन्दमिवाजितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Making this king our commander, best of kings, we can win victory, as the gods did with unconquered Skanda."

verses.text:
तथोक्ते द्रोणपुत्रेण सर्व एव नराधिपाः ।
परिवार्य स्थिताः शल्यं जयशब्दांश्च चक्रिरे ।
युद्धाय च मतिं चक्रूरावेशं च परं ययुः ॥

meaning.en: When Drona's son had said this, all the kings surrounded Shalya, raised cries of victory, made up their minds to fight and were filled with great ardor.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनः शल्यं भूमौ स्थित्वा रथे स्थितम् ।
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा रामभीष्मसमं रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, standing on the ground before Shalya in his chariot, joined his palms and spoke to him, who in battle was equal to Rama and Bhishma.

verses.text:
अयं स कालः संप्राप्तो मित्राणां मित्रवत्सल ।
यत्र मित्रममित्रं वा परीक्षन्ते बुधा जनाः ॥

meaning.en: "This time has come, friend of friends, when wise people test whether someone is a friend or a foe."

verses.text:
स भवानस्तु नः शूरः प्रणेता वाहिनीमुखे ।
रणं च याते भवति पाण्डवा मन्दचेतसः ।
भविष्यन्ति सहामात्याः पाञ्चालाश्च निरुद्यमाः ॥

meaning.en: "Be our hero and leader at the head of the army. When you go to war, the dull-minded Pandavas and the Panchalas with their ministers will lose their heart."

verses.text: शल्य उवाच

meaning.en: Shalya said:

verses.text:
यत्तु मां मन्यसे राजन्कुरुराज करोमि तत् ।
त्वत्प्रियार्थं हि मे सर्वं प्राणा राज्यं धनानि च ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever you think I can do, king of the Kurus, I will do it. All that I have, my life, kingdom and wealth, is for your pleasure."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
सेनापत्येन वरये त्वामहं मातुलातुलम् ।
सोऽस्मान्पाहि युधां श्रेष्ठ स्कन्दो देवानिवाहवे ॥

meaning.en: "I choose you as commander, uncle without equal. Protect us, best of fighters, as Skanda protected the gods in battle."

verses.text:
अभिषिच्यस्व राजेन्द्र देवानामिव पावकिः ।
जहि शत्रून्रणे वीर महेन्द्रो दानवानिव ॥

meaning.en: "Be anointed, king of kings, as the fire's son was for the gods; kill the enemies in battle, hero, as Mahendra killed the Danavas."
